purpose: Manual/automated review guide for prompt driving_v2_3 conditional estimates; not model output, not an acceptance threshold or new runtime input
epistemic_distinctions: Acquisition/ego/calibration records are supplied evidence; environmental metric quantities and futures are model hypotheses.
A reasoned finite conditional estimate is allowed without claiming future truth has already been observed.
Finite uncertainty is an adopted scenario/coordinate range, not a calibrated probability or guaranteed error bound.
Tool-chain success is conditional on hypotheses and envelope coverage; G2/real-world correctness remains separate.

review_checks.question: Do environmental hypotheses cite actual image/time pairs and use the acquired reference?
red_flags: invented reliable timestamp
GT/map value introduced into a runtime hypothesis
ego compensation presented as dynamic actor alignment

review_checks.question: Is model_metric_hypothesis accompanied by the cues actually used, meaningful metric assumptions and limitations?
red_flags: intrinsics alone called proof of scale
parallax claimed for stationary ego without observable relative geometry
unsupported calibrated_ground_plane merely renamed
unexplained round dimensions selected to fit a path

review_checks.question: Does each numerical extent play a reasoned role in a stated conditional model?
red_flags: all uncertainty set to zero without basis
arbitrarily huge box inserted merely for array validity
finite numbers asserted as calibrated or proven error bounds

review_checks.question: Were plausible actor/entrance modes formed from evidence/context rather than tailored to optimizer success?
red_flags: mode removed because it collides
actor shrinkage or road enlargement after rejection without new basis
assuming other drivers yield or avoid collision only because ego intends to proceed/stop

review_checks.question: Are reasonably plausible nearby occluded/entering actors retained even if currently outside the center region?
red_flags: unbounded_unknown=false by fiat
nearby unknown entrance dropped as outside target_region
review-area polygon presented as an occupancy bound without a scenario basis

review_checks.question: Do the 25 default envelopes (or configured grid) cover actor body motion for each whole interval under the adopted scenario, with alternatives retained?
red_flags: one whole-horizon entry when 25 are required
centers/endpoints used as full body coverage
static repetition without a stationary scenario
ego body/safety margin already folded into actor polygons and then added again

review_checks.question: Are quantities estimated when a credible conditional model is possible, while genuinely unrepresentable relevant quantities remain null/unknown?
red_flags: everything unmeasured automatically null solely because no absolute guarantee exists
unsupported unknowns automatically filled to achieve acceptance

review_checks.question: Does full-horizon target_region contain the initial center and intended path, with correct validity, stop deadlines and unchanged hard requirements?
red_flags: degenerate target polygon called a free region
terminal stopping box used as all-horizon region
0.2s prefix substituted for 5s planning validity
immediate stop requested for moving ego despite braking limits

review_checks.question: Are model/scene coherence, tool-chain pass, moving vs stationary prefix, and G2 truth performance reported separately?
red_flags: synthetic output called real model inference
stationary hold presented as forward driving
T4 PASS called grounding/G2 or deployment validation

experiment_reporting.versioning: Freeze new prompt identity/hash; keep old prompts/results unchanged.
experiment_reporting.comparison: Retain the same-window denominator and all failures/timeouts; separately label any new exploratory windows.
experiment_reporting.no_new_numeric_pass_threshold: This checklist does not define acceptable G2 error/coverage thresholds.
experiment_reporting.unknown_policy: A credible conditional model is permitted, never obligatory; inability to form one remains a legitimate rejection.
